PrivacyPolicy.Section1.Body: RentMate ("we", "us", "our") operates as the data controller for all personal data collected through this platform. We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your data transparently in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable data protection laws.
PrivacyPolicy.Section1.Title: 1. Data Controller
PrivacyPolicy.Section10.Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make material changes, we will update the version number and require you to re-consent before continuing to use the platform. The current version is always available on this page.
PrivacyPolicy.Section10.Title: 10. Changes to This Policy
PrivacyPolicy.Section11.Body: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us at privacy@rentmate.com.
PrivacyPolicy.Section11.Title: 11. Contact
PrivacyPolicy.Section2.Intro: We collect the following categories of personal data:
PrivacyPolicy.Section2.Item1: Registration data: email address, username, and password (hashed)
PrivacyPolicy.Section2.Item2: Profile data: first name, last name, phone number, city, profile picture, and biography
PrivacyPolicy.Section2.Item3: Rental data: item listings, rental requests, rental agreements, dates, and pricing
PrivacyPolicy.Section2.Item4: Payment data: transaction records, deposit amounts, and payment status (payment card details are handled directly by Stripe)
PrivacyPolicy.Section2.Item5: Usage data: IP address (hashed for cookie consent), browser user agent, and interaction logs
PrivacyPolicy.Section2.Title: 2. What Data We Collect
PrivacyPolicy.Section3.Intro: We process your personal data on the following legal bases:
PrivacyPolicy.Section3.Item1: Contract performance — processing necessary to fulfil rental agreements between users
PrivacyPolicy.Section3.Item2: Consent — cookie preferences, marketing communications, and optional analytics
PrivacyPolicy.Section3.Item3: Legitimate interest — platform safety, fraud prevention, and trust scoring
PrivacyPolicy.Section3.Item4: Legal obligation — retention of transaction records as required by applicable law
PrivacyPolicy.Section3.Title: 3. Legal Basis for Processing
PrivacyPolicy.Section4.Intro: We use your personal data to:
PrivacyPolicy.Section4.Item1: Provide the rental marketplace service and manage your account
PrivacyPolicy.Section4.Item2: Process payments and deposits, and resolve disputes
PrivacyPolicy.Section4.Item3: Communicate important updates, booking confirmations, and notifications
PrivacyPolicy.Section4.Item4: Maintain platform safety, detect fraud, and calculate trust scores
PrivacyPolicy.Section4.Title: 4. How We Use Your Data
PrivacyPolicy.Section5.Intro: We share your data only with the following third-party service providers who process it on our behalf:
PrivacyPolicy.Section5.Item1: Stripe — payment processing and deposit management (Stripe Privacy Policy applies)
PrivacyPolicy.Section5.Item2: Cloudinary — image hosting for item listings and dispute evidence
PrivacyPolicy.Section5.Note: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Data is only shared to the extent necessary to provide the service.
PrivacyPolicy.Section5.Title: 5. Data Sharing
PrivacyPolicy.Section6.Intro: We retain personal data only as long as necessary:
PrivacyPolicy.Section6.Item1: Active account data is retained for the duration of your account
PrivacyPolicy.Section6.Item2: Completed and cancelled rental records are retained for 5 years as required for accounting and legal obligations, then permanently deleted
PrivacyPolicy.Section6.Item3: Deleted reviews are permanently removed after 1 year
PrivacyPolicy.Section6.Title: 6. Data Retention
PrivacyPolicy.Section7.Intro: Under GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
PrivacyPolicy.Section7.Item1: Right of access — request a copy of all data we hold about you
PrivacyPolicy.Section7.Item2: Right to rectification — correct inaccurate or incomplete data
PrivacyPolicy.Section7.Item3: Right to erasure — request deletion of your personal data (subject to legal retention obligations)
PrivacyPolicy.Section7.Item4: Right to data portability — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
PrivacyPolicy.Section7.Item5: Right to restriction — request that we limit processing of your data
PrivacyPolicy.Section7.Item6: Right to object — object to processing based on legitimate interest
PrivacyPolicy.Section7.Title: 7. Your Rights
PrivacyPolicy.Section8.Body: You can exercise most rights directly through your account settings: download your data, deactivate your account, or delete your account from the Security page. To contact us directly about a data request, or to request reactivation after an administrative action, please email privacy@rentmate.com.
PrivacyPolicy.Section8.Title: 8. How to Exercise Your Rights
PrivacyPolicy.Section9.Intro: We use the following categories of cookies:
PrivacyPolicy.Section9.Item1: Necessary cookies — required for core platform functionality (authentication, security, language preferences). These cannot be disabled.
PrivacyPolicy.Section9.Item2: Analytics cookies — help us understand how visitors use the site so we can improve it. Only set with your consent.
PrivacyPolicy.Section9.Item3: Marketing cookies — used to show relevant advertisements and measure campaign effectiveness. Only set with your consent.
PrivacyPolicy.Section9.Note: You can manage your cookie preferences at any time using the "Manage Cookie Preferences" link in the footer.
PrivacyPolicy.Section9.Title: 9. Cookie Policy
